findings.title: Removed mark_failed helpers without updating imports/mocks that target that module path
findings.body: This module previously defined `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and `SimpleCheckIn`. The refactor deletes all of them and does not re-export the new names, which now live in `sentry.monitors.logic.incidents` (`try_incident_threshold`), `sentry.monitors.logic.incident_occurrence` (`create_incident_occurrence`), and `sentry.monitors.types` (`SimpleCheckIn`). Any test that imports one of these from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (for example a `get_failure_reason` unit test) will now raise ImportError, and any `patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")` no longer intercepts the production code path because the call site moved to `sentry.monitors.logic.incidents`, so occurrence-production assertions would silently stop exercising the real path. No test files are updated in this PR, so references must be migrated to the new module locations.

findings.title: Monitor context returns raw config instead of the computed display config
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor_environment.monitor.config` into a local `config` and replaces `config["schedule_type"]` with `get_schedule_type_display()`, but the returned dict sets `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` rather than the local `config`. The human-readable schedule type substitution is therefore dead code, and the occurrence's monitor context contains the raw internal `schedule_type` value instead of the display string, producing incorrect data in the issue occurrence payload. Return the mutated `config` (or remove the dead copy/conversion).
